text: Why does gcd(a, b) calling gcd(b, a % b) still terminate?
choices: The second argument is a non-negative integer that strictly decreases, which is enough
Because a and b are always positive
Because it decreases by one each time
explanation: The variant argument does not require the decrease to be by one. This corresponds to strong induction — assuming the claim for all smaller values rather than just the previous one — which is also the shape of binary search and merge sort.
